answer: Reputation decay stops sybil farms from banking trust. Each agent's score shrinks by a fixed fraction every epoch unless it submits fresh work graded by a random jury, so an idle reputation becomes a relic within weeks. The kernel of the defense is recurring cost: an attacker running 1,000 fake identities must pay compute and risk failed grades for all 1,000 every epoch, not once. Joining can be velvet-soft; staying credible is expensive.
